# First-School.ws

> > Comprehensive resource for preschool and kindergarten teachers offering printable activities, lesson plans, crafts, and worksheets organized by educational themes.

First-School.ws (also known as Primera Escuela) is a dedicated platform for early childhood educators providing bilingual lesson plans and ready-to-print materials. The site covers thematic learning units, seasonal activities, holiday crafts, and foundational skills like alphabet, numbers, handwriting, and colors designed for preschool through early elementary learners.

## Key Topics

- Preschool Activities
- Printable Worksheets
- Lesson Plans
- Coloring Pages
- Educational Crafts
- Alphabet Learning
- Numbers & Counting
- Handwriting Practice
- Holiday Themes
- Seasonal Activities
- Early Childhood Education
- Kindergarten Resources
- Bilingual Learning
- Interactive Puzzles
- Educational Games

## Core Resources & Hubs

- [First-School Preschool Activities and Crafts](https://first-school.ws): Homepage featuring preschool activities, crafts and lesson plans
- [Preschool Themes and Lesson Plans](https://first-school.ws/themes.html): Main collection of preschool themes and bilingual lesson plans
- [Printable Activities for Preschool and Kindergarten](https://first-school.ws/preschool/printable-activities/index.htm): Central hub for printable worksheets, games and crafts

## Foundational Skills

- [Alphabet Printable Activities | Worksheets, Coloring Pages and Games](https://first-school.ws/theme/alphabetp1.htm): Alphabet worksheets with multiple handwriting styles
- [Handwriting Worksheets and Printable Activities Preschool, Kindergarten and Elementary](https://first-school.ws/theme/handwriting.htm): Handwriting practice worksheets in multiple manuscript formats
- [Numbers Printable Activities for Preschool and Kindergarten](https://first-school.ws/theme/numbers_preschool_printables.htm): Number worksheets and counting practice for early math learners
- [Colors Theme Preschool Activities and Crafts](https://first-school.ws/theme/colors.htm): Color learning activities and crafts for preschool students
- [Farm Alphabet Printable Activities](https://first-school.ws/theme/animals/coloring-pages/farm-alphabet.htm): Farm animal alphabet worksheets with handwriting practice

## Thematic Learning Units

- [Animals Theme Preschool Activities and Crafts](https://first-school.ws/theme/animals.htm): Animals-themed lesson plans with various animal categories
- [Fairy Tales Preschool Activities and Crafts · Folk Tales - Tall Tales and Legends](https://first-school.ws/theme/fairytales.htm): Fairy tales and folk tales activities for early elementary learners
- [Fables Preschool Activities and Crafts](https://first-school.ws/theme/fables.htm): Aesop's fables-themed activities with moral lesson crafts

## Seasonal & Holiday Activities

- [Holidays Preschool Activities and Crafts](https://first-school.ws/theme/holidays.htm): Holiday-themed activities and crafts for preschool learners
- [Spring Season Activities and Crafts for Kids](https://first-school.ws/theme/seasons_spring.htm): Spring season-themed activities and crafts for young learners
- [Easter Preschool Activities and Crafts](https://first-school.ws/theme/h_easter.htm): Easter-themed crafts and worksheets for preschool learners
- [March Holidays and Events Activities and Crafts for Kids](https://first-school.ws/theme/occasions3.htm): March holiday activities featuring historical figures and events
- [April Holidays and Events Activities for Kids](https://first-school.ws/theme/occasions4.htm): April holiday activities including Easter and Earth Day themes

## Creative Activities & Games

- [Coloring Pages for Toddlers, Preschool and Kindergarten](https://first-school.ws/theme/cpgeneral.htm): General coloring pages collection for early learners
- [Online Jigsaw Puzzles for Toddlers, Preschool and Kindergarten](https://first-school.ws/theme/onlinepuzzle.htm): Interactive online jigsaw puzzles for toddlers and preschoolers

## Teacher Resources

- [First-School.ws Preschool Materials List](https://first-school.ws/materiallist.html): Shopping guide for preschool classroom supplies and materials
